description: A document naming an unknown top-level `adapter: bogus` plus a `use` effect, which would otherwise reach the factory's own build. Preflight catches the unknown name first (`cli/runtime_shim.py:868` runs before `:911`), so the run fails with preflight's own text, not the factory's raw `Unknown adapter: ...` -- and the message's own trailing `.` produces `..` before `Re-run`.
